title: The First Social Network: In rural Argentina residents send messages w AM radio
summary: A New Yorker article exploring how rural Argentina residents have transformed AM radio into a grassroots social network, using it to communicate messages, news, and maintain community connections in areas lacking internet infrastructure.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of modern communication infrastructure in rural communities by repurposing existing AM radio technology as a social networking platform.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how communities innovate with accessible technology to maintain social bonds and information sharing when digital infrastructure is unavailable.
